zh.widget.deepseek-balance.name: DeepSeek 余额
zh.widget.deepseek-balance.desc: DeepSeek 官方开放平台余额：充值 / 赠送余额、按本机观测的今日消耗，以及本次对话的花费（≈ 为按当前费率估算）
zh.widget.deepseek-balance.simToggle: 余额充足 / 偏低 / 不足 / 未配置
zh.deepseek.title: DeepSeek 余额
zh.deepseek.insufficientHint: 账户余额不足，DeepSeek 已暂停该账号的 API 调用；充值后自动恢复
zh.deepseek.lowHint: 余额低于你设的预警阈值 {low}
zh.deepseek.spentHint: 今日消耗＝host 采样余额得到的当日下降量之和（官方只提供余额、没有用量接口）：dsh 未运行期间的消耗不计入，充值 / 赠送不计为负消耗
zh.deepseek.estHint: 对话消耗按当前费率估算整段会话：会话记录里没有逐请求时间戳，无法把高峰 / 低谷分开计价（≈）
zh.deepseek.unconfigured: 未配置 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY — host 自动读取环境变量 / $DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml / .env，重启后自动生效
zh.deepseek.unauthorized: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 被拒绝（401）— 检查密钥是否仍然有效
zh.deepseek.unloaded: dsh web 未重启，等待 host 路由加载（重启后自动刷新）
zh.deepseek.timeout: DeepSeek 余额接口超时，稍后自动重试
zh.deepseek.unavailable: DeepSeek 余额接口暂不可用
zh.card.deepseek-balance.lowHint: 余额低于该值时大数字转为警示色（低于一半为红色）；默认 10，单位与账户币种一致

en.widget.deepseek-balance.name: DeepSeek Balance
en.widget.deepseek-balance.desc: Official DeepSeek platform balance: topped-up / granted credit, today's spend as observed by this machine, and this conversation's cost (≈ = folded at the current rate)
en.deepseek.title: DeepSeek Balance
en.deepseek.insufficientHint: The account has no usable balance, so DeepSeek has stopped serving its API calls; it recovers after a top-up
en.deepseek.lowHint: Balance is below your alert threshold of {low}
en.deepseek.spentHint: Today's spend sums the balance drops this host sampled (the official API publishes a balance only, no usage): spend while dsh was not running is not counted, and a top-up is not counted as negative spend
en.deepseek.estHint: This chat's cost is folded at the rate in effect now: the session record carries no per-request timestamps, so peak and off-peak hours cannot be priced apart (hence the ≈)
en.deepseek.unconfigured: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY is not configured — the host auto-reads env / $DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml / .env; effective after a restart
en.deepseek.unauthorized: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY was rejected (401) — check that the key is still valid
en.deepseek.unloaded: dsh web not restarted — waiting for the host route (auto-refresh after restart)
en.deepseek.timeout: The DeepSeek balance endpoint timed out; it retries automatically
en.card.deepseek-balance.lowHint: The big figure turns amber below this balance (red below half of it); default 10, in the account's own currency
